name: prompt-os
description: Entry point to the Notion Portfolio Prompt OS: identify the app, fetch the Prompt Router, select one Agent-Ready workflow, resolve dependencies, execute within boundaries, and record the run.

interface.shortDescription: Route work to canonical Notion Prompt OS workflows.
interface.longDescription: The retrieval-and-routing entry point for the SH portfolio. Identifies the current app, fetches its Apps record and the canonical Prompt Router, selects one Agent-Ready primary workflow, resolves required calls, prerequisites, and tool adapters, validates tools/variables/approvals, executes within declared boundaries, and records the run in Prompt Runs / Evals.
defaultPrompt: Route this task through the Portfolio Prompt OS.
Find the canonical workflow for this app and run it.
Which Agent-Ready prompt applies to this repository?
